_doc: The referenced⇒present known-gaps baseline (M27.D, KF-48 instance 1). Same discipline as known-gaps.json and registry-known-gaps.json, and the same non-negotiable: a gap IN this baseline is reported KNOWN and the run still exits 0; a gap OUTSIDE it exits 1; a baseline entry NO LONGER observed (phantom) also exits 1, so a closed gap cannot rot here unnoticed. THE BASELINE IS EMPTIED BY ADDING THE MISSING GENERATION ROWS — NEVER by loosening the derivation. It opened at ELEVEN entries' worth of gap and was emptied to one by adding ten rows in the same stage, because a baseline is a record of judgement deferred, not a place to park a red run. WHAT MUST NEVER GO IN HERE: a kit-only validator. Kit-only is decided by the honest label on the validator's own reference line ('kit-only, not copied into projects'), read AT THE SITE — baselining an exemption would let a silent omission wear the same clothes as a declared one, which is the exact confusion this check exists to remove (owner ruling, 2026-07-24).

gaps.why: Named by templates/PROJECT-CLAUDE.md's enumeration and by the generated pr-smoke.yml, but generated by no row — and it must NOT be, yet. It is the research_publish mode's validator, and the row schema still cannot express an operating_mode conditional: applicable() knows tiers/locus/deliverable/risk_armed only, so a row added today would render validate-sources.cjs into every greenfield project that has no sources registry to police. It is the third entry of the same cluster already declared in registry-known-gaps.json (docs/sources/registry.md, docs/paper): the whole research_publish artifact set is unrowed for one shared reason. Closing it needs a mode-conditional renderer, which M27.D's scope puts outside a KF-48 stage — filed as tech debt so the judgement is made deliberately rather than by silence. NOT a licence to leave it: the validator ships in the kit and the mode's own playbook depends on it.
